evidence.dom: hitsに占有率の定量開示なし。subscription-based products/services『constituted approximately 78% and 77% of total revenues』で経常収益基盤は強いが、自社が『low barriers to entry』を明記。定性的にITリサーチ主導と仮定し70(寡占リーダー・未定量につき保守)
evidence.irr: 『approximately 80% to 85% of the Company's annual and multi-year Insights subscription contracts provide for billing of the first full service period upon signing』+ subscription 78% of revenue → 多年契約の移行摩擦=高摩擦70
evidence.rep: 『Limited barriers to entry exist in the markets in which we do business』『low barriers to entry exist』(2度明記)+『We anticipate encountering more competition with increased adoption of AI services』→ 数年で追随可=35。『breadth and depth of our proprietary insights positions us well versus our competition』は一部相殺材料
evidence.dur: 堀の実体は『proprietary insights』のブランド/評判(Magic Quadrant型)。network/規制/物理/スイッチングコストの強い保護は無く、low barriers明記→ブランド型55
evidence.erosion: 『increased competition could result in loss of market share, diminished value in our products and services, reduced pricing』(条件付リスク文・未顕在)→emerging
evidence.disrupt: 『We anticipate encountering more competition with increased adoption of AI services in the markets in which we compete』→AIが研究/助言モデルを脅かす=threat
evidence.expiry: コンセッション/特許束等の期限型独占なし=no
evidence.moatdecay: low barriers to entry(×2)+『loss of market share』リスク+AI競争+opm 20.9%→15.8%低下=yes
evidence.geopol: 『termination-for-convenience from various US government agencies for approximately $3.0 million of contracts』(immaterial)+『the current geopolitical environment remains unpredictable, we continue to monitor』→軽微〜中=1
evidence.nrr: NRR非開示→既定105。subscription 78% of revenue+多年契約は高リテンションの傍証だが定量なし
evidence.p2: COVID(2020)営利490.1M(vs2019 370.1M・+32%)で下落せず耐性。ただし2008-09型のIT予算不況は5年窓外・Consulting『project-based and non-recurring』(9%)は循環的→70上限側に置き75
evidence.p3: nde=1.03 <2.5→70。cash$1.7Bでnet debtは低位だが自社株買いで自己資本薄化(次期eq63.4M)
evidence.p4: accr=-6.9%(<0)+『material weakness』ヒットは監査基準の定型文(『assessing the risk that a material weakness exists』=手続説明で実指摘でない)+『ITEM 1B. UNRESOLVED STAFF COMMENTS. None』→90
evidence.f2: TAM浸透の定量開示がhitsに無し→保守側65(注記: 数値なきため概念的当てはめ)
evidence.f3: R&D/売上の明示シグナルなし業態+『loss of market share』リスク→正符号なし=55
evidence.f4: 『Consulting segment revenues constituted approximately 9% of total revenues』(>5%)だが『project-based and non-recurring』。Conferences等隣接あるも成長不確実→育成中60
